'''Teydo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]], who lived during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He worked as a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]]. When a group of agents from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daimar]] traveled to the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Emthuul's]] on the planet [[Byrsym]], Teydo was present in the bar and was engaging in an argument with a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]].
